edition_angle: Focusing on developmental programming and physiological aging pathways across sexes using the provided preprint candidate.

assignments.angle: Investigating how gestational protein restriction programs sexually divergent behavioral aging, early affective vulnerability in males, and late-life mnemonic preservation at a hedonic cost in females.
assignments.reason: This preprint offers a concrete physiological and behavioral model linking early-life nutritional programming to long-term aging outcomes across sexes, perfectly fitting our criteria and balancing away from recent heavily concentrated cognitive decline stories.
